blocks.content: The Todo module is a simple task list for the DMAIC project. Each task has a description, a due date, an owner, and a status.
Open, In Progress, Done, or Blocked. Status is changed directly in the table.
Overdue tasks are automatically highlighted in red.
Use the calendar icon to show a task in the project calendar. Requires both text and due date to be filled in.
The table can be filtered by status, owner, and free text. Column headers are sortable.

items: Click "+ Add Task" to create a new task.
Fill in text, due date, and owner directly in the table.
Change status via the dropdown in the status column.
Use the filters above to filter by status, owner, or keyword.
Click a column header to sort the list.
